# CONSOLIDATA
Canonical: https://cdatats.com/
Language: English
For owners of already-selling US consumer businesses deciding what marketing spend deserves another round.
Marketing Checkup: USD27 once plus applicable tax. Ten selected-answer questions produce a browser-local fixed-rule self-assessment report with strengths, unknowns, up to three priorities and discussion prompts. Notes do not change findings.
Purchase: https://cdatats.com/checkout.html — hosted Stripe payment, followed by a shareable questionnaire URL. No account, order-authenticated access, cloud report storage or automatic email delivery. The questionnaire URL is not proof of payment.
No external AI analysis, account audit, advertising campaign execution, or guaranteed commercial result is included. Save/download the report before closing. Further services and calls are optional and separately agreed.
